query: Standalone Rust CLI for blazing-fast local code search: fast regex over large codebases respecting .gitignore; plus fuzzy and structural AST search

mustHaveCapabilities: fast regex search over large codebases
fingerprint.desiredOutcome: One standalone CLI with regex plus fuzzy and structural search

payload.title: ast-grep
payload.snippet: CLI tool for code structural search, lint and rewriting. Written in Rust. Parallel Rust. Syntax-aware grep/sed. Structural search and replace via AST patterns. No plain regex grep mode. No fuzzy matching.

payload.title: ripgrep
payload.snippet: Line-oriented search tool that recursively searches directories for regex patterns. Respects .gitignore. Blazing fast Rust. No fuzzy matching. No structural AST search. Published as library crates ignore and grep-searcher.

payload.title: nucleo-matcher
payload.snippet: Plug and play high performance fuzzy matcher library crate. Faster than fzf, skim, fuzzy-matcher. Used by helix-editor. Library not a CLI. Fuzzy matching only, no regex, no structural search.

payload.title: comby
payload.snippet: Code rewrite tool for structural search and replace supporting many languages. Written in OCaml. No regex grep mode. No fuzzy matching.

payload.title: probe
payload.snippet: AI-friendly semantic code search engine for large codebases. Combines ripgrep. Rust. Semantic/embedding search focus.

payload.title: fuzzy-matcher
payload.snippet: Fuzzy Matching Library crate. Older, slower than nucleo. No regex, no structural search.

payload.title: ignore
payload.snippet: Fast library for efficiently matching ignore files such as .gitignore against file paths. Part of ripgrep. 164M downloads.
